RimCourt.Court.PetitionDef.label: a plea for sanctuary
RimCourt.Court.PetitionDef.description: A traveller asks to be taken in and given a place in the colony.
RimCourt.Court.PetitionDef.arrivalText: {PETITIONER_labelShort} has walked in from the wilds and asks to be heard by the lord. {PETITIONER_pronoun} left {FACTION} with nothing and wants a place here, offering {SILVER} silver of savings for the privilege.\n\nHold court within {DAYS} days or {PETITIONER_objective} will move on.
RimCourt.Court.PetitionDef.caseText: {PETITIONER_labelShort} stands before the court with nothing but what {PETITIONER_pronoun} carries. {PETITIONER_pronoun} asks for a roof, a place at the table, and the lord's protection. There is talk of {PETITIONER_possessive} savings, some {SILVER} silver, which {PETITIONER_pronoun} would rather keep.\n\nHow does the lord rule?

li.label: Let {PETITIONER_labelShort} buy a place for {SILVER} silver

RimCourt.Court.PetitionDef.label: a claim for redress
RimCourt.Court.PetitionDef.description: A traveller robbed near your land comes to claim damages from the lord.
RimCourt.Court.PetitionDef.arrivalText: {PETITIONER_labelShort} of {FACTION} has arrived at your gate, robbed on the roads you claim as yours. {PETITIONER_pronoun} wants {SILVER} silver in damages and will wait for the lord to hear it.\n\nHold court within {DAYS} days or {PETITIONER_objective} will take the story home instead.
RimCourt.Court.PetitionDef.caseText: {PETITIONER_labelShort} was set upon near your borders and lost everything on the road. The claim is simple: these are the lord's lands, so this is the lord's debt. {SILVER} silver would settle it.\n\nHow does the lord rule?

li.label: Charge {SILVER} silver in court fees, then refuse
